source_text:
Can you help with this 象-2000 issue? (no evidence id)

QUOTE

fragments.text: Can you help with this 象-2000 issue?

reply_text:
I'm tracing why the "Yes" turn had no evidence id when the agreement check ran. The id only gets set if futon1b acknowledges the turn synchronously, so I'm checking that path and futon1b now.The "Yes" turn did reach futon1b in the end (my replay got a 409, meaning the id already exists). I'm checking that the stored entry really is the Yes, because the 409 body quoted codex-10's text.I've found the cause. Before changing anything else, I'm checking whether other sessions are affected the same way.㊥ (why your "Yes" wasn't checked) Your "Yes" did reach codex-10, and it has started the work. What failed is the agreement record. Agreeing needs the id of your "Yes" in the evidence store, and that turn never got stored. The same is true of every codex-10 turn since 20:50 yesterday. Each turn is stored as a reply to the turn before it. Since then, every turn has been turned down because the turn it replies to is missing. About 156 turns are sitting in the outbox's `failed` folder, and that folder deletes records once they are a day old. The oldest go at about 20:50 tonight. Shall I replay them in order now, so your "Yes" lands and I can record the agreement against it?

㊢ (how I traced it) Your "Yes" is still queued in `~/.local/state/futon3c/evidence-outbox` (id `emacs-0fbd64ac…`). futon1b turns it down with `409 reply-not-found`: the turn it replies to (`emacs-c9b9e384…`, a turn-commits record from 13:21) was never stored. I walked that reply chain backwards. Every link is in `failed/`, back to the first two records at 2026-10-01 20:50:18. That was a turn that ended in `[curl error (exit 18)]`. Those two went straight to `failed/` with 0 attempts, and the last stored turn is `emacs-06293cf0…`. One other session has a single failed record. No other session is affected.

㊩ (the defect) If one turn is turned down for good, every later turn in that session fails too. Each new turn points at the missing one through `in-reply-to` (`agent-chat-emit-turn-evidence!`, `futon3c/emacs/agent-chat.el:3920-3925`), so the session's evidence stops for good, with no visible sign until something needs an evidence id. I don't know why those first two records were turned down at 20:50. When I replayed them just now, both were accepted.

㊢ (what I changed) I replayed three records by hand:
- **By mistake, codex-10's reply after your Yes:** I picked the wrong outbox file at first. futon1b turned it down, so nothing was written.
- **The two 20:50 records:** both were accepted (201), so they are now in futon1b. That's what the outbox would have done if they hadn't failed, but I should have asked first.

I haven't moved or deleted anything in the outbox, so it won't post them again.

㊭ (repair) I'd do it in two steps:
1. Replay the remaining ~154 records in order, oldest first. Each one then finds its predecessor. Your "Yes" drains on the outbox's next retry, and I post the agreement against `emacs-0fbd64ac…`. That's about 150 writes, spaced out so futon1b isn't flooded.
2. Make the emitter stop chaining from a turn that was turned down for good: drop or re-point `in-reply-to` instead of naming a missing turn. That's a small code change, and I'd bell it to a Codex seat.

🈸 (one decision) Shall I do step 1 now, before the retention window starts deleting records tonight?
